European Commission May 2026 Segregated Plot Carve-Out Protocol
When statutory deforestation is localized, PWRI-3D performs automated geometric vector subtraction:
P_export = P_declared \ V_3a → Quarantines red violation zone, salvages 100% of compliant sub-polygon.
Figure 2. Algorithmic architecture of the Pixel-Wise Raster Intersection (PWRI-3D) statutory adjudication engine.
The system executes a tri-axial tensor synthesis directly within Google Earth Engine combining 10m spatial rasters (EC JRC 2020, Nature Trace, Sentinel-1 Radar),
temporal trajectories (2000 → 2020 → 2025), and statutory ontologies distinguishing illegal deforestation (Art. 3(a)) from exempt agricultural replanting (Art. 2(5)) and silviculture (Art. 2(3)).
The May 2026 Carve-Out Protocol delists the non-compliant polygon and generates customs-ready Due Diligence Statements (TARIC C716) with SHA-256 cryptographic provenance.
